headline: A cleaner ServeSync workspace with your preferred appearance.
highlights: Desktop Home, Events, Announcements, and navigation have clearer layouts and easier-to-scan information.
New desktop sessions start in light mode; Android and mobile PWA sessions start in dark mode. Your saved Light, Dark, or System choice remains in place.
Event and announcement details stay in desktop dialogs, and assignment links open the correct schedule.
Song leaders can add songs to approved setlists from a desktop dialog. Changes return the setlist to Draft for another review.
